executable_template.applicability_check: Pass PATH or PYTHONPATH before a trusted quality executable, a cd argument containing command or variable expansion, an arbitrary command followed by &&, or trailing command substitution; each must be rejected while a literal cd and literal GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE remain valid only for the ref-bound diff-quality helper.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Fail tokenization unless the whole command is one command or one literal cd prefix followed by one command, reject shell expansion syntax anywhere, and strip only unique literal GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE assignments for the exact ref-bound diff-quality helper.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the tokenizer and environment allowlist hardening with its focused regressions; disable acceptance of report-only shell-command evidence until an equivalent fail-closed parser is available.
